title: Prepare planning ignore rules
responsibility: Prepare additions to existing clean registry and formatter ignore files for planning artifacts.

inputs.name: planRegistry.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planRegistry.revision
inputs.description: Revision containing the existing configuration files.

outputs.name: planningIgnores
outputs.description: Planning artifact glob patterns for all six supported categories.

outputs.name: planRegistry
outputs.description: Map of only the configuration files needing additions; absent configurations are not created. This helper returns proposed bytes without writing them.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects unsafe or dirty configuration paths and invalid existing registry JSON/schema; read failures propagate.

dependencies.contract: Validate existing Harness unit configuration with the public unitsConfigSchema before additive ignores.
